title: Faithfully flat extension preserves regular sequences
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. If $x_1,\ldots,x_r$ is an $R$-regular sequence, with $r\geq0$, its image in $A$ is an $A$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Regular includes that the final quotient is nonzero.
